title: SignificanceRuleTable
description: Shape of one historical significance rule file, data/history/rules/{rule_id}.json - ONE RULE PER FILE, so adding a rule never changes an existing rule's file hash (ADR-0014 section 5). Read at boot by the assembling binary and passed to the pure history core as values; the core never reads files. A golden test binds rule_version to (a) this file's normalised content hash and (b) the core's output on a fixed input: changing a value without raising rule_version fails. The rule's CONDITION is Rust code, not data (HSE section 33: explicit rules first); this file carries the rule's identity and its output constants only. It must not carry inputs taken from other data tables (e.g. rarity) - ADR-0014 section 5. Boot check: rule_version starts with rule_id + '@'.

produces_event_type.description: Historical event type this rule produces. NOT named `event_type`: `command_type`/`message_type`/`event_type` are reserved as top-level discriminator keys of contract objects (ADR-0002 section 1a) - a data table using one of them is misread as a message by generic dispatch code (client report, p1-02).

evidence_type.description: HSE evidence type of the automatic evidence created per record. p1-02: SHIP_LOG. Closed set that grows with rules.
